scripts.test:dev: cross-env CYPRESS_ENV=dev npx cypress open --browser electron
scripts.test:stg: cross-env CYPRESS_ENV=stg npx cypress open --browser electron
scripts.test:prod: cross-env CYPRESS_ENV=prod npx cypress open --browser electron
scripts.test:dev-lexgpt: cross-env CYPRESS_ENV=dev npx cypress run --spec 'cypress/sites/default/e2e/lexgpt/lexgpt_ask_questions.cy.js' --browser chrome --headless
scripts.test:stg-lexgpt: cross-env CYPRESS_ENV=stg npx cypress run --spec 'cypress/sites/default/e2e/lexgpt/lexgpt_ask_questions.cy.js' --browser chrome --headless
scripts.test:stg-lexgpt-vib: cross-env CYPRESS_ENV=stg npx cypress run --spec 'cypress/sites/vib/e2e/lexgpt/lexgpt_ask_questions.cy.js' --browser chrome --headless
scripts.playwright:test:api: cd playwright && npx playwright test tests/lexgpt-api.spec.ts
scripts.playwright:test:api-verbose: cd playwright && npx playwright test tests/lexgpt-api.spec.ts -v
scripts.playwright:test:ui: cd playwright && npx playwright test tests/lexgpt-api.spec.ts --ui
scripts.playwright:debug: cd playwright && npx playwright test tests/lexgpt-api.spec.ts --debug
